text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios's debut race is here! The 
vibes are immaculate and she's totally 
pumped!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't nervous in the slightest. In 
front of Mejiro Palmer, who came to cheer 
her on, she fired herself up with pure 
hype to completely steal the show!
